description: Price a machine the company's computations run on, from a day on — the company's owner and administrators only. The same machine and 'validFrom' replaces that row; another day adds one, and the earlier row keeps pricing the days before it, so a past month stays at its own price. kind 'monthly' (default) needs monthlyPrice and cores: a machine rented by the month or our own; 'computeCores' says how many of its cores computations get (default all) — only that share can stand idle. kind 'tariff' prices by the second: coreSecond, memoryGiBSecond and gpuRates ('H100=0.001097, A100-80GB=0.000694'). Always say where the price came from: 'source' (the provider's page, or 'invoice'), 'checkedOn', 'basis' (list, invoice, estimate) and, where the plan was only matched by cores and memory, typeAssumed=true. Never invent a price: a machine with no row has no cost.

checkedOn.description: The day the source was looked at, YYYY-MM-DD.

computeCores.description: monthly: how many of the cores computations get; default all.

coreSecond.description: tariff: one core for one second.

cores.description: monthly: its cores (threads where the runner counts threads).

currency.description: Currency of every price on the row: 'EUR', 'USD' (default).

gpuRates.description: tariff: GPU-second prices by type, 'H100=0.001097, L4=0.000222'.

machine.description: The machine as its runner reports it, e.g. 'kimmy', 'ax42', 'modal'.

memoryGiB.description: Its memory in GiB, for the record.

memoryGiBSecond.description: tariff: one GiB of memory for one second.

monthlyPrice.description: monthly: what the whole machine costs a month.

note.description: How the price was arrived at — an estimate's formula.

source.description: Where the price was read: the page's address, or 'invoice'.

typeAssumed.description: True where the plan was matched by cores and memory, not confirmed.

validFrom.description: The first day this price is in force, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: set_machine_price
title: Set machine price
